description: Query background job information from SAP's SM37 transaction. Returns job status, execution times, and scheduling details.

date_from.description: Start date in YYYYMMDD format (default: last 7 days)

date_to.description: End date in YYYYMMDD format (default: today)

status.description: Job status: F=Finished, A=Aborted, R=Running, S=Scheduled, P=Ready

name: sap_read_jobs
